created_by: evidence audit subagent, all numbers traced to a file on disk and recomputed where derivable
one_line: A monotone projection on the DR intensity refused 2,033 PI-law shrink requests across three seeds and applied none; against fixed DR it passed its preregistered 2-of-3 tolerance rule at 3/3 on all four AUC components, but the mean paired frontier-success gain is only +0.597 pts with a one-sided 95% lower bound of -3.19 pts, so this is a DECISION, not equivalence, and two of three seeds favour fixed.

the_rule.statement_in_words: The intensity scalar lambda may expand or hold; a PI-law decrease is refused. The relative return guard remains the only path that can lower lambda.
the_rule.statement_in_symbols_as_realized: lambda_{n+1} = max(lambda_n, lambda_tilde_{n+1}) on every non-guard iteration; on a guard trip the update is lambda_{n+1} = max(lambda_min, return_decay * lambda_n) and the max-projection is bypassed.

implementation.call_sites: lines 279 and 319 (the two non-guard update paths)
implementation.guard_bypass: the guard branch at lines 248-261 returns before _apply_floor is reached

the_rule.scope_of_the_rule: It is a projection on ONE scalar intensity in [0.0, 1.0] that scales the physical DR ranges; it is not a per-parameter support projection.
the_rule.expansion_half_never_exercised: lambda_max = 1.0, so once lambda reaches the envelope the rule can only hold, never climb further. The 'may expand' half of the rule was never tested above the ceiling.

mechanism_blocked_requests.caveat_requests_are_not_independent: The 2,033 refusals are correlated per-iteration controller events inside three runs, not 2,033 independent samples. The statistical n for any policy comparison is 3.
mechanism_blocked_requests.caveat_guard_is_still_a_downward_path: The rule blocks only PI-law decreases. A return-guard trip may still lower lambda. In these three runs the guard never tripped (0/3 seeds, 0 rows), so no decrease was ever applied; the claim 'blocks every shrink request' is exact for what happened but is not an absolute floor by construction.

same_seed_same_controller_contrast.statement: Same controller, same seed, same everything, differing only by the monotone projection: 17.32 frontier success-AUC points. This is the cleanest statement of C2 available.
same_seed_same_controller_contrast.caveat: Seed 8601 is the seed selected for the ratchet screen AFTER its collapse was observed (preregistration selection_disclosure). It is a targeted mechanistic regression test, not a blinded efficacy seed. It is also the single seed of three on which the ratchet beat fixed.

dashboard_inversion_for_the_never_shrink.hygiene: -0.73 is a SPEARMAN rank correlation. Pearson is -0.61 overall and -0.60 among controllers.

preregistered_rule.text: After confirmatory cells, each frontier co-primary is within 0.02 of fixed in >=2/3 paired training seeds, and each in-envelope co-primary is within 0.01 in >=2/3 paired seeds. Exact seed counts and deltas are reported; no p-value is claimed at n=3.

headline_frontier_success.recompute_method: statistics.mean / statistics.stdev(ddof=1) on the three paired delta_pts; LB = mean - t(0.95, df=2) * sd / sqrt(3)

the_plus_3.125_is_seed_noise.why: It is the single positive draw of three and the sign flips across seeds. The preregistered informative sub-test -- ratchet minus fixed positive on BOTH 8600 and 8602 with each gap above +3.0 pts, prior probability about 0.4% under pure seed noise -- did NOT trigger; both new seeds are negative.

decision_not_equivalence.required_sentence: The rule was fixed before the data and it passed; that is the decision it was written to make. It is not a demonstration of equivalence. With three seeds and a paired standard deviation of 2.25 points, the one-sided 95% lower bound on the frontier-success difference is -3.19 points, which lies outside the 2-point margin.
decision_not_equivalence.prereg_says_so_itself: hypotheses.superiority = 'Not preregistered. A positive point estimate over fixed is descriptive and cannot turn the Tier-1 signal constraint into a superiority claim.'

why_the_tie_is_close_to_structural.finding: Over the post-warmup run the never-shrink arm and fixed DR are distributionally identical.
why_the_tie_is_close_to_structural.consequence: The two arms share an identical training distribution over 98.87% of post-warmup training, differing only by a ~70-iteration warm-up ramp and RNG stream divergence. The H_R2 tolerance test is therefore close to structurally guaranteed and carries little information about capability. Say this in the paper; it is why the ratchet's informative comparator is the UNCONSTRAINED controller, not fixed DR.

realized_exposure_at_the_envelope.unit: iterations at the pinned intensity (single cohort); for these single-cohort arms episodes and environment-iterations give the same 0.9925

seed_effect_that_bounds_every_claim.consequence: Any one-seed screen must be read against a paired noise floor of 2.25 pts on the four-cell frontier AUC and 2.74 pts on the {phys_175, phys_200} band.

scope_and_caveats_that_must_travel_with_: Three paired training seeds (8600, 8601, 8602). All three influenced development; they are REPLICATION, never untouched confirmation.

Seed 8601 was selected for the ratchet screen AFTER its unconstrained collapse was observed. The preregistration discloses this: 'a targeted mechanistic regression test, not a blinded efficacy seed'. It is also the one seed of three that favours the ratchet.

Fixed seeds 8600 and 8601 come from the earlier campaign generation via a reconstructed historical bridge; only fixed 8602 was newly trained for the confirmation. Disclosed in the amendment's claim_scope.comparator_disclosure.

One motion: walk_hands_on_back_loop_002__A066_M, a 4.03 s single walk clip, evaluated with 512 episode aliases per cell. Many aliases improve within-policy precision; they do NOT create independent trained policies and give no motion-generalization evidence.
1,024 environments, 8,000 PPO iterations from scratch per training cell. Environment-iterations, not episodes.
The rule acts on ONE scalar intensity in [0, 1] scaling the physical DR ranges; it is not a per-parameter support projection, and its 'may expand' half was never exercised because lambda_max = 1.0.
The return guard remains a legal downward path. It never tripped in these three runs, so the observed trajectories are strictly monotone, but the rule is not an absolute floor by construction.
No p-value is claimed at n = 3 (preregistration). The one-sided 95% lower bound reported here assumes a t(2) reference distribution on three paired differences and is itself a very weak instrument.
The never-shrink arm and fixed DR are the same training distribution over 98.87% of post-warmup training, so the tolerance pass is near-tautological and must not be described as a hard-won result.
The ratchet does not rehabilitate the latent mismatch signal; the same-day signal audit disqualified it on five runs.

what_c2_does_not_establish: Not equivalence with fixed DR. The one-sided 95% lower bound is -3.19 pts, outside the 2-point margin.
Not superiority over fixed DR. Explicitly not preregistered and explicitly not authorized by the receipt.
Not a directional claim: claim_scope.directional_claim_authorized = false.
Not generalization beyond the single training motion and its 512 aliases.
Not a claim that the latent mismatch gap became a calibrated difficulty signal.
Not evidence that the 'may expand' half of the rule does anything: lambda_max = 1.0 was the ceiling.
